# flock

```go
import "github.com/rou-cru/takt-ai/takt/internal/flock"
```

Package flock takes exclusive advisory file locks with a bounded wait.

## Constants

<a name="PollInterval"></a>PollInterval is how often a waiting Exclusive retries the lock.

```go
const PollInterval = 20 * time.Millisecond
```

## Variables

<a name="ErrTimeout"></a>ErrTimeout is returned when the wait ended before the lock was free; it wraps the context error that ended it.

```go
var ErrTimeout = errors.New("lock wait ended")
```

<a name="Exclusive"></a>
## func Exclusive

```go
func Exclusive(ctx context.Context, f *os.File, wait time.Duration) error
```

Exclusive takes the exclusive advisory lock on f, retrying until ctx ends or wait elapses. It never closes f.
